wheel.notes: Wheel is pure-Python (py3-none-any), correct for a Python-only package.

sdist.notes: sdist includes .github/ workflows and docs/ — slightly bloated but not blocking.

pyinstaller_binary.spec_notes: target_arch=None (native arch); universal binary requires separate build-universal-mac.sh run with two venvs.

docker_image.live_inspect_note: docker manifest inspect returned error — image not yet pushed or registry not public

homebrew_formula.resource_versions_note: pydantic 2.13.4, typer 0.25.1, rich 15.0.0, etc. — all pinned to specific versions with sha256s.

macos_app.codesigning: none — no codesign_identity; Gatekeeper quarantine removed by install.sh via xattr

inconsistencies: pyproject.toml version=0.1.0 but git tag=v0.1.0-alpha: semver pattern in docker-publish.yml emits tag '0.1.0-alpha' (not '0.1.0')
Homebrew formula URL uses owner 'macworkers' but git remote is 'merchloubna70-dot'

reproducibility.checksums_notes: No standalone checksums.txt or .sha256 files in dist/ or repo root

publishable.pypi_notes: PYPI_API_TOKEN secret not set (release.yml step guarded by 'if: env.PYPI_API_TOKEN != '''). Would publish if secret is added.
publishable.docker_ghcr_notes: Workflow triggers on v*.*.* tags; GITHUB_TOKEN used for GHCR write. linux/amd64 + linux/arm64 declared.
publishable.homebrew_notes: Formula sha256 does not match local sdist AND repo owner in URL is wrong ('macworkers' vs 'merchloubna70-dot'). Formula will 404 on install.
publishable.github_release_notes: release.yml attaches dist/* to the GitHub Release on tag push. Both wheel and sdist will be attached.

findings.title: Homebrew formula sha256 mismatch
findings.detail: Formula sha256=744375fb... but actual sdist sha256=1ad26fcf.... These will diverge further at release time because the GitHub Release asset will be rebuilt from CI (different timestamp). Formula must be updated post-release using the CI-built sdist sha256.
findings.fix: After CI builds and uploads the release sdist, run: shasum -a 256 autodev_ai-0.1.0.tar.gz and paste into Formula/autodev-ai.rb.

findings.title: Homebrew formula URL points at wrong GitHub owner
findings.detail: Formula url=https://github.com/macworkers/autodev-ai/... but git remote is github.com/merchloubna70-dot/autodev-ai.git. 'brew install' will 404.
findings.fix: Replace 'macworkers' with 'merchloubna70-dot' in the url and homepage fields of Formula/autodev-ai.rb.

findings.title: Info.plist version does not match pyproject.toml
findings.detail: CFBundleShortVersionString=1.0 and CFBundleVersion=1.0 in Info.plist; pyproject.toml version=0.1.0. macOS software update and Gatekeeper records will show '1.0' instead of '0.1.0'.
findings.fix: Update Info.plist CFBundleShortVersionString and CFBundleVersion to '0.1.0'.

findings.title: Git tag 'v0.1.0-alpha' vs pyproject version '0.1.0' — alpha suffix not in package version
findings.detail: docker-publish.yml semver pattern emits '0.1.0-alpha' as Docker tag. PyPI would receive '0.1.0' (release). This is intentional for a pre-release but must be documented: the GHCR tag will be '0.1.0-alpha' while pip install autodev-ai==0.1.0 would install the same wheel.
findings.fix: Either tag as 'v0.1.0' for a release or set pyproject.toml version='0.1.0a1' to make PyPI aware of alpha status.

findings.title: Docker base image not pinned by digest
findings.detail: Dockerfile uses 'python:3.12-slim' (floating tag). A silent base image change can break reproducibility.

findings.title: PyInstaller version not pinned
findings.detail: build.sh runs 'pip install --quiet pyinstaller' with no version constraint. A PyInstaller major update could silently break the binary.
findings.fix: Pin: 'pip install --quiet pyinstaller==6.*' or add pyinstaller to a requirements-build.txt.

findings.title: GHCR image live manifest not verifiable pre-push
findings.detail: docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/merchloubna70-dot/autodev-ai:latest failed — image not yet pushed. Multi-arch (amd64+arm64) is declared in the workflow but cannot be verified until after first tag push.
findings.fix: After first tag push, run: docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/merchloubna70-dot/autodev-ai:latest to confirm both platforms are listed.

findings.title: No checksums file for dist artifacts
findings.detail: dist/ contains wheel and sdist but no checksums.txt / SHA256SUMS. build.sh prints sha256 to stdout but does not write a file.
findings.fix: Add a post-build step: shasum -a 256 dist/* > dist/SHA256SUMS to support verification.

findings.title: PyPI publish gated on PYPI_API_TOKEN secret
findings.detail: release.yml step 'Publish to PyPI' is guarded by 'if: env.PYPI_API_TOKEN != ''''. No token = no publish. README badge points at PyPI (https://pypi.org/project/autodev-ai/) but package is not published there.
findings.fix: Add PYPI_API_TOKEN secret to the GitHub repo, or remove the PyPI badge from README until published.

verdict_detail: GitHub Release and GHCR Docker publish are functional. Three blockers must be resolved before Homebrew tap and macOS .app distribution: wrong repo owner in formula URL (404 on brew install), sha256 mismatch in formula, and Info.plist version mismatch. PyPI is currently gated on a missing secret.
